steps.title: More money, fewer residents
steps.text: Real spending rose 21% since FY2016 while population fell; per resident it rose 28%.

steps.title: Where it went
steps.text: Homelessness and health grew fastest in real terms.

steps.title: Overtime
steps.text: $471 million in FY2025, mostly public safety, where minimum staffing rules and vacancies drive it.

steps.title: Did it work?
steps.text: Departments met 68% of FY2025 targets. Outcome measures are met less often than outputs.

steps.title: Are the targets honest?
steps.text: 13 measures dropped, 247 targets made easier. The met share is only as good as the measures.

steps.title: Budget vs actual
steps.text: Public safety overspends (overtime); housing underspends (projects lag). Both are capacity stories.
